name: Akiyama Mizuki
source:
Mizuki's a moody person who loves cute things. They were captivated by [url=/c128189]Kanade[/url]'s music upon listening to it, and like to upload MVs online. This caught Kanade's attention, and Mizuki was thus invited to join "25-ji, Nightcord de." However, Mizuki has a secret that no one else in the group knows about...

They're the animator of the underground music circle 25-ji, Nightcord de.

[From in-game profile]
